title: Transfer learning with ResNet-18

paper.title: How transferable are features in deep neural networks?
paper.year_note: Original/preprint year except GCN (2017 venue, 2016 preprint) and speculative decoding (2023 venue, 2022 preprint).

statement: Implement Transfer learning with ResNet-18: fit a small licensed image subset with frozen and fine-tuned pretrained ResNet-18; document weight provenance. Read the linked paper and isolate the named mechanism. Write a self-contained solve(data), fit using training tensors only, and return Submission(model=model). Keep validation labels out of fitting and preprocessing. This is an educational reduced-scale adaptation, not a claim to reproduce original paper results. Use small-image-subset; required output: Image -> class logits. Evaluate accuracy (maximize). Record ResNet-18 checkpoint license hash preprocessing and frozen parameters. Required ablation: Compare scratch frozen-backbone and full-finetuning runs with the same split. Curriculum draft: reference, task-specific objective/evaluation adaptation and thresholds remain unimplemented; a named dataset may have a loader but this does not make this model executable. The provided solution raises NotImplementedError.
